bottleneck.description: Largest Chinese industrial laser equipment maker (cutting, marking, PCB drilling) competing with Raycus, MaxPhotonics, IPG and TRUMPF.

dependency.key_customers: Chinese EV/battery makers, PCB fabs, consumer-electronics assembly lines
dependency.key_suppliers: Domestic laser-source vendors (Raycus, MaxPhotonics) plus optics importers

editorial.notes: Han's is the volume leader in China across laser marking/cutting machines (claimed >70% domestic share in marking historically and #1 in metal cutting today), but the underlying tech is contested with multiple Chinese and foreign substitutes. Customers can switch suppliers within a single procurement cycle, and most segments are commoditizing. Genuine bottleneck status would require a unique capability, which is absent.
